dialogues.speaker: Sanjay
dialogues.text: I... can keep going! I can still do it...

dialogues.speaker: Sanjay
dialogues.text: Look, there are still so many goods waiting to be moved... If I slow down, it's going to affect the economic development of Port Ormos...

dialogues.speaker: Sanjay
dialogues.text: For the sake of... the port's trade flow... I must...
